description: Static scaffold and PWA shell: the verbatim SQL file, index.html + styles.css app shell, manifest.webmanifest, the sw.js service worker, and the dependency-free icon generator (RUN to produce the two PNGs). This feature contains no app JS logic; it establishes every static asset the shell precache (design §16) enumerates, so later features' modules slot into an already-correct shell. Independent of FEAT-002/003 logic but must come first because sw.js PRECACHE and manifest reference files whose NAMES are fixed by design §2/§16 and index.html loads ./js/app.js (created in FEAT-003).
steps: Create supabase_schema.sql by copying the SQL block from prompt.txt VERBATIM: 4 `create table if not exists` (spesa_products, spesa_list, spesa_pantry, spesa_wishlist with the exact columns shown), 4 `create index if not exists ..._user_updated`, 4 `alter table ... enable row level security`, and all 16 `create policy` (4 per table, select/insert/update/delete with auth.uid() = user_id). Do NOT add IF NOT EXISTS / drop policy / any guard to the policies; do NOT alter column names/types; NEVER include workouts/exercises/weight_log. (design §17)

Create index.html (design §9/§16): header with app title, a manual 'Sincronizza' button, and an account/sync status chip; a <main id="view"> container the router renders into; a fixed bottom nav with exactly 4 buttons (Spesa, Dispensa, Desideri, Prodotti), each >=44px tap target with active-state styling; <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest">; theme-color meta #2e7d5b; mobile viewport meta; <script type="module" src="./js/app.js"></script>. All strings Italian.

Create styles.css (design §9): CSS variables in :root for the brand palette (brand #2e7d5b), spacing, radius; layout for header/main/bottom-nav; components — toast, action sheet / popover (the 3-dots kebab), modal, autocomplete suggestion list, quantity editor, bottom-nav active state; expiry state styles (scaduto = red, in-scadenza = amber, neutral); 44px minimum tap targets; a @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) override block. No light/dark toggle UI.

Create manifest.webmanifest (design §16): name 'Spesa', short_name 'Spesa', start_url './', scope './', display 'standalone', background_color and theme_color '#2e7d5b', lang 'it', icons array with icon-192 (192x192) and icon-512 (512x512), both type image/png and purpose 'any maskable'.

Create sw.js (design §16): cache name 'spesa-cache-v1'; install event pre-caches EXACTLY the enumerated §16 PRECACHE list (./, ./index.html, ./styles.css, ./manifest.webmanifest, ./icons/icon-192.png, ./icons/icon-512.png, and every js module: ./js/app.js, ./js/db.js, ./js/store.js, ./js/supabase.js, ./js/sync.js, ./js/router.js, ./js/ui.js, ./js/units.js, ./js/views/spesa.js, ./js/views/dispensa.js, ./js/views/desideri.js, ./js/views/prodotti.js, ./js/views/auth.js) — NOT sw.js, supabase_schema.sql, README.md, tools/, and NOT the esm.sh module; do NOT auto-call skipWaiting. activate: delete old caches + clients.claim(). fetch: network-first for navigation requests and same-origin .js/.css/.html; cache-first for icons/manifest and any https://esm.sh/ origin (lazy-cache esm.sh module + its transitive esm.sh imports on first online load; fall through to network on opaque/CORS caching failure). message: on {type:'SKIP_WAITING'} call self.skipWaiting().

Create tools/generate-icons.mjs (design §12): Node ESM, ZERO npm deps — use only built-in zlib and Buffer. Build valid non-empty PNGs by hand: 8-byte PNG signature, IHDR, a single IDAT (raw RGBA raster, one filter byte 0 per scanline, zlib.deflateSync), IEND, with correct CRC32 per chunk. Produce a 192x192 and a 512x512 PNG with a shopping-basket glyph on a rounded-square brand #2e7d5b background (basic in-JS rasterization; acceptable fallback per design §12 is a solid rounded-square brand PNG if the glyph rasterization is too costly). Write to icons/icon-192.png and icons/icon-512.png (create the icons/ directory).
RUN the generator: `node tools/generate-icons.mjs` to produce the two PNGs. Confirm they are non-empty and start with the PNG signature.
acceptance_criteria: supabase_schema.sql matches the prompt.txt SQL block exactly: 4 create table, 4 create index, 4 enable row level security, 16 create policy; zero occurrences of workouts/exercises/weight_log.
`node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.webmanifest','utf8'));console.log('ok')"` prints ok and the manifest declares both maskable icons.
`node --check sw.js` passes; the PRECACHE array lists exactly the §16 entries (./ + 6 shell assets + 13 js modules) and esm.sh appears only in the fetch cache-first branch, never in PRECACHE.
index.html parses, loads ./js/app.js as a module, links the manifest, and has exactly 4 bottom-nav targets with the Italian section names.
`node tools/generate-icons.mjs` exits 0 and icons/icon-192.png + icons/icon-512.png exist, are non-empty, and begin with bytes 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A.
verification: Grep supabase_schema.sql and sw.js and index.html for workouts|exercises|weight_log and confirm zero matches
findings: Shell + PWA scaffold complete and verified. Static files live at repo root: index.html, styles.css, manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, supabase_schema.sql. ICON PATHS/SIZES (for manifest/sw/index references): icons/icon-192.png (192x192, image/png, purpose 'any maskable') and icons/icon-512.png (512x512, same). Both generated by `node tools/generate-icons.mjs` (zero npm deps, built-in zlib+Buffer; hand-rolled valid PNGs: brand #2e7d5b rounded square + white shopping-basket glyph). Sizes: 192 -> 1349 bytes, 512 -> 4235 bytes; both begin 89504e470d0a1a0a. SQL copied VERBATIM from prompt.txt: 4 create table, 4 create index, 4 enable RLS, 16 create policy; zero workouts/exercises/weight_log. sw.js CACHE_NAME 'spesa-cache-v1'; PRECACHE has exactly 19 entries (./ + index.html + styles.css + manifest.webmanifest + 2 icons + 13 js modules), matching design §16 by name; esm.sh appears ONLY in the fetch cache-first branch, never in PRECACHE; sw.js does NOT auto-skipWaiting (waits for {type:'SKIP_WAITING'}). SHELL-MARKUP DECISIONS for later features: index.html loads ./js/app.js as a module; header has h1.app-title 'Spesa', a status chip #sync-chip (data-state attr: ok/error toggles chip styling; default text 'Non collegato'), and a manual #sync-btn ('Sincronizza'); router mounts into <main id="view" class="app-view">; bottom nav has 4 .nav-btn buttons each with data-route attribute '/spesa','/dispensa','/desideri','/prodotti' (Italian labels Spesa/Dispensa/Desideri/Prodotti) and an .active class for the current route (app.js/router.js must toggle .active and wire data-route -> navigate). styles.css exposes CSS vars under :root (brand --brand #2e7d5b, spacing --sp-*, radius --radius*, --tap 44px) plus a prefers-color-scheme:dark override and ready-made component classes later features can reuse: .toast(.info/.success/.error) + .toast-wrap, .overlay+.modal(+.modal-title/.modal-actions), .sheet(+.sheet-title/.sheet-item[.danger]/.sheet-icon) for the kebab action sheet, .autocomplete+.autocomplete-list+.autocomplete-item(.active), .qty-editor(.qty-value/.qty-unit), .row(.bought)/.row-main/.row-title/.row-sub, .kebab-btn, .expiry(.neutral/.in-scadenza/.scaduto), .btn/.btn-primary/.btn-danger, .input/.select, .empty. No app JS logic was created in this feature (js/* modules belong to FEAT-002/003). Repo had no git yet at start; see commit on current branch.
